Lina (Growth): Quick standup 10m. We're wrapping launch posts + webinar funnel. Need: final KW mapping for organic signups, JSON-LD for the landing (Event + FAQ), anchor text plan for 3 pillar posts, and a safe redirect strategy that preserves utms. Who's volunteering? :hand:
Marco-SEO: I got KW mapping. Will trim to high-intent and long-tail how-to queries. Also will propose H1/H2 swaps and meta variants.
Rae-Content: I'll draft the benchmark blurb and 2 email invite lines. One technical, one executive.
DevOps-BOT: Crawl summary: 6 pages with no Event schema, 2 redirect chains, 1 page with conflicting canonical. Snapshot: https://internal.crawl/2799999999/summary
Ivy: For schema, JSON-LD should include startDate/endDate, performer array with speaker sameAs, and potentialAction for registration. I'll prepare FAQ snippet with 5 Qs (replay, level, prerequisites, duration, slides).
CRM-Integrations: For routing, capture utm_source, utm_medium and utm_term into hidden fields. Add hidden field 'kw_orig' for utm_term so we can attribute organic KWs later. We'll map region param to SDR queues.
Lina (Growth): Internal linking: priority anchors from these pillars: 'inference economics', 'serving runtime', 'ops playbooks'. Use 2 anchor variations: "predictable inference cost" and "reduce inference latency". No links to /pricing here.
Marco-SEO: KW shortlist: "reduce inference latency", "predictable inference cost", "inference caching strategy", "dedicated GPU inference", "batching for inference". Mapping: landing H1 = "Predictable LLM inference latency and cost"; meta A highlights cost, meta B highlights latency.
Rae-Content: Benchmark hook options: Exec: "Save millions on inference spend while keeping latency predictable." Tech: "Live demo + benchmark: p50 latency, tokens saved, and batching gains." Which resonates?
Ivy: Schema inline note: don't include aggregateRating on product pages until reviews exist. For Event use OnlineEventAttendanceMode and eventStatus EventScheduled. Include sameAs for speaker LinkedIn.
DevOps-BOT: Proposed nginx redirect snippet (temp -> monitor):
```
# temp redirect to monitor conversions; preserve query
rewrite ^/promo/legacy-launch$ /webinar/inference-playbook?utm_source=legacy&utm_medium=redirect&$args redirect;
# flip to permanent after 48h
return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/inference-playbook?$query_string;
```
Will run a QA crawl 24h after flip.
Lina (Growth): Owners: Marco = KW + meta variants; Ivy = JSON-LD + FAQ; CRM-Integrations = form hidden fields + routing; Rae = benchmark copy + invite lines; DevOps-BOT = redirect QA. I'll publish the checklist and schedule a sync tomorrow 8:30am PT. Thanks! :rocket:
